title: The Originals
collections_intro: Two sides of the same village. Explore their secret roles, then decide who you can trust.
expansions.title: Expansions
expansions.intro: New arrivals. New reasons to be suspicious.
fae.name: The Fae Court
fae.intro: A friendly face by day. A tempting bargain by night. The Fae play for their own victory, and can share it with Town or Cult.
fae.contents: Two roles: the Broker and the Collector. Three bargains, one shared victory.
fae.sharing: One owner. The whole room can play.
fae.bargains_intro: Offer a gift anonymously. Ask for a promise in return.
fae.thorn.name: Thorn’s Protection
fae.thorn.description: Protection from new curses next night, for a promised vote.
fae.voice.name: A Borrowed Voice
fae.voice.description: A private report of a chosen player’s actual ballot after voting closes, for a promise to abstain today. No role is revealed.
fae.passage.name: Moonlit Passage
fae.passage.description: Vote for the named player today to hide your visit next night. Only a kept promise earns the passage; other abilities still affect you.
intro: Your character is cosmetic. Your secret role decides your side and abilities. These are the possible roles, not a reveal of who has them. Classic preserves the familiar lineup; its Illusions variant adds haunting and forged readings. Hard introduces Tracker and Herbalist alongside more deceptive roles. Chaos draws a fresh cast with possible duplicates. Paranoia keeps the dealt role counts secret and lets anyone make a public oath. Custom uses the host’s exact role counts. Check the room’s Modes settings for your gathering.
